name: baseline-pre-refactor
purpose: Frozen state of DREAM ML before any refactor or cleanup (Phase 0, task 0.3). Every before/after comparison in the thesis uses this snapshot.

ci.backend_coverage_note: coverage.py total for api and apiTimeSeries only. Sonar's 36.1 % also counts the frontend, which has no tests.

latest_analysis_at_export.note: Commit 94a7254 only added documents outside sonar.sources. Its analysis has the same values as e02c0bb for ncloc, bugs, vulnerabilities, code_smells, security_hotspots, coverage and duplicated_lines_density (checked with api/measures/search_history on 2026-11-13). The exported JSON files come from this latest analysis.

quality_profiles.note: Values read at export time (2026-11-13). The Python profile was updated by SonarSource on 2026-11-10, after both baseline analyses, so a new analysis of the same code may not reproduce these counts. Compare before and after with analyses run under the same rules.

quality_gate.name: Sonar way
quality_gate.note: The branch status omitted new_coverage, most likely because the analysed new code had too few lines for Sonar to apply it; the condition is part of the gate. Risk R1 in the Phase -1 plan.

config_files_sha256.note: Hashes of the files at e02c0bb. A later measurement with different hashes uses different exclusions or coverage scope.

files.export_sonar.py: Script that produced the sonar-*.json files
files.sonar-analyses.json: Analyses of the branch, with dates and revisions
files.sonar-measures-by-file.json: Per-file size, complexity, duplication, coverage and issue metrics
files.sonar-issues.json: Every issue with rule, severity, location and status
files.sonar-quality-config.json: Quality gate status and definition, and quality profiles
files.ci-run/: Coverage and test results downloaded from CI run 42134886141
